The Mirror is one of the oldest and most trusted news brands in the UK and we have now launched in the USA. Since 1903 we have brought words and pictures from the most important world events to millions of readers - and we continue in our commitment to doing that. We will bring you the very best in news, entertainment and sport worldwide to bring our award-winning journalism and distinct perspective to the USA. We proudly champion issues that matter to individuals. Whether it be giving a voice to those who can’t speak for themselves or holding those in power to account, our first thought is always you - the reader.
